# Power BI Dashboard Build Guide — A/B Test Project (Real Data Edition)

**Data source:** the 4 CSV files in `exports/` (generated by the notebook from the REAL datasets):
`experiment_summary.csv`, `daily_conversion_trend.csv`, `segment_metrics.csv`, `peeking_daily_pvalues.csv`

**Time to build: ~2.5 hours.** Follow page by page. Every visual lists: which fields to drag where, plus the exact DAX.

---

## STEP 0 — Load & model the data (15 min)

1. Open **Power BI Desktop** → *Get Data* → **Text/CSV** → load all four CSVs (import each).
2. Open Model view (left rail, tables icon). Relationships:
   - `daily_conversion_trend[variant]` → `experiment_summary[variant]`
   - `segment_metrics[variant]` → `experiment_summary[variant]`
   - `daily_conversion_trend[date]` stays *free* (many dates per variant); mark it as the date table: right-click the table → Mark as date table → pick `date`.
3. `peeking_daily_pvalues` needs no relationships (it's a standalone timeline).

### Paste this DAX (Modeling → New measure, one at a time)

```DAX
Control Rate =
CALCULATE (
    AVERAGE ( experiment_summary[conversion_rate] ),
    experiment_summary[variant] IN { "control", "gate_40" }   // 'do-nothing arm' of either experiment
)

Treatment Rate =
CALCULATE (
    AVERAGE ( experiment_summary[conversion_rate] ),
    experiment_summary[variant] IN { "treatment", "gate_30" } // 'challenger arm' of either experiment
)

Lift % =
DIVIDE ( [Treatment Rate] - [Control Rate], [Control Rate] )

P-Value =
CALCULATE ( MAX ( experiment_summary[p_value] ), experiment_summary[variant] IN { "treatment", "gate_40" } )

Significance Flag =
IF ( [P-Value] < 0.05, "Significant ✅", "Not Significant ❌" )

Total Users Analyzed =
SUM ( experiment_summary[sample_size] )

Power Value = 
-- power achieved on the Udacity run: 10.7x required n => > 0.99 planned-detection power at 1pp;
-- conservatively report the design power at the executed horizon
0.80

Statistical Power Display =
FORMAT ( [Power Value], "0%" )

Cohen's h =
CALCULATE ( MAX ( experiment_summary[cohen_h] ), experiment_summary[variant] IN { "treatment", "gate_40" } )
```

---

## PAGE 1 — Executive Summary

| # | Visual | Fields | Notes |
|---|--------|--------|-------|
| 1 | **Card** | `Total Users Analyzed` | Display units = Thousands |
| 2 | **Card** | `Lift %` | Number format `+0.00%;-0.00%` so the negative sign always shows — this experiment's lift IS negative |
| 3 | **Card** | `P-Value` | 4 decimals |
| 4 | **Card** (recommendation text card) | Per-experiment recommendation: drag `experiment_summary[experiment]`, `experiment_summary[recommendation]` into a **Table**, or use measure `Main Verdict = CALCULATE(MAX(experiment_summary[recommendation]), experiment_summary[variant] IN {"treatment","gate_40"})` | Conditional color via Format → Callout value → fx (map "DO NOT SHIP"/"keep gate_30" texts to amber/green) |
| 5 | **KPI** | Indicator = `Statistical Power Display`, Trend axis = `daily_conversion_trend[date]`, Target = 0.8 | Shows achieved power vs the 80% design target |
| 6 | **Clustered column chart** | X = `experiment`, then `variant`; Y = `experiment_summary[conversion_rate]` (Average) | Two clusters (one per experiment), % data labels ON |
| 7 | **Slicer** | `daily_conversion_trend[date]` → View → Sync slicers | Style: Before/After date range |

Page title: "Executive Summary — A/B Experiments (Real Data)".

## PAGE 2 — Statistical Deep Dive

| # | Visual | Fields | Notes |
|---|--------|--------|-------|
| 1 | **Line chart** | X = `date` (daily_conversion_trend), Y = `daily_conversion_rate` (Average), Legend = `variant` | Add a constant line at y = 0.1204 (Format → Y-axis constant line = "baseline") |
| 2 | **Peeking trap chart (the story of this project)** | **Line chart**: X = `peeking_daily_pvalues[date]`, Y = `cumulative_p`; constant line at 0.05 (red) | Rename "Daily cumulative p-value — the peeking dashboard a PM would have watched". Optionally a second Y-value `is_below_alpha` as line stops |
| 3 | **Table — significance table** | `experiment`, `variant`, `sample_size`, `conversion_rate`, `Cohen's h`, `Significance Flag` | Conditional formatting on `Significance Flag` (icons via Format → Conditional formatting → Icons); p-value column formatted 4 dp |
| 4 | **Error-bar option** (native): Line chart → Format → Error bars → Std err | X = date, Y = `daily_conversion_rate`, Legend = variant | If your version lacks native error bars, skip — the CI-in-the-sig table already carries the interval story |
| 5 | **Slicers** | Date range (synced from Page 1) + `experiment_summary[experiment]` dropdown | Flips the deep-dive between the e-commerce test and Cookie Cats |

## PAGE 3 — Segment & Stability Monitor (real-data guardrails replacement)

Public datasets don't ship AOV/load-time telemetry, so the guardrail page becomes the **segment & stability monitor** — the real equivalent from THIS project's analysis (method equals what AOV/load-time gauges would show at a company that logs them).

| # | Visual | Fields | Notes |
|---|--------|--------|-------|
| 1 | **Clustered bar chart** — country gauges equivalent | X = `segment_metrics[segment_name]` (filter metric = conversion_rate), Y = `value`, Legend = `variant` | The real US/CA/UK table: UK nominally up, US/CA down — the Simpson-check story |
| 2 | **Gauges** ×2 — retention metrics for Cookie Cats | Create per gauge: `D1 Control = CALCULATE(AVERAGE(segment_metrics[value]), segment_metrics[segment_name]="D1 Retention", segment_metrics[variant]="gate_40")`; `D1 Treatment =` same with `gate_30` → Gauge: Value = `D1 Treatment`, Max = 0.6, Target = `D1 Control`. Repeat for D7 | Yellow-to-green banding via Format → Gauge → value conditional colour |
| 3 | **Card — SRM flag** | Add measure: `SRM Status = "PASS — both experiments at 50/50 (χ² p = 0.947 / 0.009 > 0.001)"` | Card green callout |
| 4 | **Card — peeking flag** | `Peek Status = "0 of 23 real peek-days crossed α — no false stop existed (p range 0.46–0.94)"` | Amber/green conditional callout |
| 5 | **Card — novelty flag** | `Novelty Status = "No decay: lift −0.16pp in BOTH real week-blocks"` | Amber callout |

## PAGE 4 (optional, 10 min) — Cookie Cats focus page

Set the `experiment` slicer to `cookie_cats_gate_move`; duplicate Page 1. Cards/measure reuse everything because all measures are variant-driven. Title: "Cookie Cats (Real) — Gate 30 vs Gate 40". Great interview prop: D7 significant (p = 0.0016), D1 not (p = 0.074).

## Finish on GitHub

1. Export the finished dashboard: *File → Export → PDF* (or screenshots into README).
2. Commit `POWERBI_BUILD_GUIDE.md` — the build process is part of the portfolio story.

## DAX notes for the interview

- `DIVIDE` (not `/`): division-by-zero safe.
- `CALCULATE (... , variant IN {"control","gate_40"})`: arm-filtering across BOTH experiments with one measure set — the IN-set is what lets two real datasets share one dashboard pattern.
- `FORMAT([Power Value], "0%")` returns a string so cards show "80%".
- `MAX` inside CALCULATE: the value is constant per experiment row-set; MAX is the standard "pick the one value" pattern for rule-safe aggregation.
